latency_breakdown.note: T2->T5 (upload) includes HTTP multipart upload from browser + disk write on server. T6 (job creation) includes DB insert + FastAPI response. All backend timings are measured on localhost. Network latency ~0 ms loopback.

architecture_comparison.name: A. Current: Full Upload -> Backend Processing
architecture_comparison.notes: Current bottleneck: upload must complete before CV starts.

architecture_comparison.name: B. Chunked Upload + Progressive Backend Processing
architecture_comparison.implementation_complexity: MEDIUM -- requires fragmented MP4 (faststart moov), partial VideoCapture support
architecture_comparison.accuracy: Same as A if full resolution preserved
architecture_comparison.reliability: MEDIUM -- partial-file VideoCapture is brittle on non-faststart MP4
architecture_comparison.deployment: Requires chunked multipart upload + backend buffer management
architecture_comparison.notes: FEASIBILITY: Requires MP4 with moov atom at file START (-movflags faststart). Current Traffic1.mp4 moov position: FRONT. VideoCapture on partial files is unreliable with standard OpenCV. NOT recommended without explicit re-mux pipeline.

architecture_comparison.name: C. Browser-Side ONNX/WebGPU Inference
architecture_comparison.implementation_complexity: HIGH -- requires onnxruntime-web or TF.js, WASM/WebGPU runtime
architecture_comparison.accuracy: Same model -- identical if float32 precision maintained
architecture_comparison.reliability: MEDIUM -- WebGPU availability varies; WASM slower than native
architecture_comparison.notes: Eliminates upload bottleneck. NOT measured -- theoretical comparison only.

architecture_comparison.name: D. Live Camera / RTSP Stream
architecture_comparison.implementation_complexity: HIGH -- requires RTSP client, live buffer management
architecture_comparison.deployment: Infrastructure camera required; backend RTSP reader
architecture_comparison.notes: Not applicable to current uploaded-video use case.

optimization_candidates.recommendation: Investigate chunked upload with moov faststart re-mux if first-box latency target < 1 s.

optimization_candidates.reducible: PARTIAL -- GPU would reduce to ~5-15 ms; smaller input size reduces accuracy
optimization_candidates.accuracy_impact: HIGH if resolution reduced; NONE if GPU used at same resolution
optimization_candidates.recommendation: GPU backend (CUDA/OpenVINO) is the primary lever for RTF >= 1.0.

optimization_candidates.reducible: YES -- pre-load model at server startup (already done once per job; amortize across jobs)
optimization_candidates.recommendation: Pre-warm YOLOX at server startup. Already: model loaded once per job, not per-frame.
